titleEn: A Bite of Green Leaves, Too!

pages.text: "I don't like green!" Middle child Mina pushed green leaves onto Sonu's plate. Three plates sat on the yard platform for dinner. With the river low and distant, the space in front was wide.
"Let's race to the yard's edge after dinner!" Mina ate only white rice. Round-bellied youngest child Sonu happily chewed the extra leaves. Mom looked at Mina's empty greens section.
The next morning, Mom trimmed the remaining leaves. Mina brought their trunk close. "What do these taste like?"
Under the big yard tree, a goat gobbled green leaves. "The goat seems to like them." Mina watched quietly.
After eating, the goat hopped into the yard. Mina asked Mom, "Are those my vegetables, too?" "I blanched our leaves separately."
At dinner, Mom brought out the leafy side dish. "Would you taste a little?" Mina chose one small leaf.
Mina gathered courage and took a crunchy bite. "...Oh? It tastes nutty!" Then rice with leaves. "A Bite of Green Leaves, Too!" Mina ate again.
"They're better with rice." Mina looked up. Mom patted their knee and smiled. "Would you like a little more?"
After the meal, Mina ran into the yard. "Sonu, let's play!" Their trunk lifted high toward the sky.
Mom hugged Mina as they ran back. "I'll try a little tomorrow, too." Mina smiled in her arms.
